name: Pluto

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 mention found in web search or on pluto.trade; company is a CFTC-regulated derivatives exchange for compute (materially complete DCM/clearinghouse applications), a heavily regulated buyer/operator profile
Company site markets 'The Market for Compute' with no security/trust page or SOC 2 badge found

hiring_signals: Senior Software Engineer - AI Infrastructure ($250K-$300K) — founding-infra-type role (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/pluto)
Chief Compliance Officer ($200K-$300K) — direct compliance buildout signal (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/pluto)
Head of Compute Sales / Head of Compute Markets (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/pluto/jobs/LyijONR-head-of-compute-markets)
aws_evidence: No cloud provider named on YC profile or site; job posts reference large-scale AI systems and GPU infrastructure (H100/A100/B200) but not a specific cloud (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/pluto)
pitch_note: CFTC-regulated exchange with no visible SOC 2, actively hiring a Chief Compliance Officer and a senior infrastructure engineer — compliance buildout is happening right now and SOC 2 will be table stakes for institutional counterparties. Ideal timing for a Type I engagement.

name: BlindPay

soc2_evidence.signal: Third-party product listing quotes BlindPay marketing copy claiming 'SOC 2 compliance', but this could not be verified on BlindPay's own site
BlindPay's own /compliance page mentions FinCEN MSB registration and KYC/KYB but contains no SOC 2, audit, or Vanta/Drata language; /security returns 404

hiring_signals: 0 jobs listed on YC profile; is_hiring=false (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/blindpay)
aws_evidence: CTO Gabriel Lyra formerly worked at AWS and at LendingClub optimizing AWS infrastructure costs; no explicit statement of BlindPay's own cloud found (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/blindpay)
pitch_note: Fresh $3.3M seed, $125M+ processed, ex-AWS CTO, and a compliance page with no SOC 2 attestation shown — a stablecoin payments API selling to fintechs will get security-questionnaired constantly. Caveat: old launch marketing copy claimed 'SOC 2 compliance', so verify status on the first call.

name: Ritivel

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or 21 CFR Part 11 certification mentioned anywhere on ritivel.com; security is marketed via 'fully local deployment' and zero data retention instead of third-party attestation
Sells AI drafting of CTDs/CSRs/INDs/BLAs to pharma regulatory teams — highly regulated enterprise buyers who require vendor security attestation

hiring_signals: No open roles found; is_hiring=false on YC data, team of 3 (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/ritivel)
aws_evidence: Site explicitly markets '100% local deployment', 'No cloud storage. Fully local deployment. Your documents stay inside your infrastructure.' (https://www.ritivel.com/)
pitch_note: Sells into pharma regulatory teams — buyers who will demand SOC 2 in every vendor review — and currently has zero certifications, leaning on 'local deployment' messaging instead. Caveats: W26 (very early, 3 people, YC-only funding) and their on-prem posture weakens the AWS-native angle.

name: Luthor

soc2_evidence.signal: Company blog post 'Luthor Reaches SOC 2 for Safer AI Compliance for RIAs' announces completed SOC 2 certification after ~6 months of work

hiring_signals: Software Engineer, $120K-$180K, SF/Remote US — only open role (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/luthor/jobs)

contacts.name: Glenn Espinosa
contacts.role: Co-founder & CEO (ex Risk/Compliance Eng at Square)

pitch_note: Disqualified for Type I outreach: Luthor already completed and publicly announced SOC 2 certification. Only residual angle is Type II renewal/continuous-compliance support down the line.

name: Lakonia

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2, FedRAMP, or CJIS mention found on lakonia.us.com or in web search; sells AI C2/comms transcription to law enforcement and military — regulated government buyers, but their compliance path is more likely CJIS/FedRAMP than SOC 2

hiring_signals: No open roles found; is_hiring=false, team of 2 (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/lakonia)
aws_evidence: No cloud provider evidence found; product targets tactical/edge environments (https://www.lakonia.us.com/)

contacts.name: Gordy Sun
contacts.role: Co-founder (Stanford EE/CS, 8VC Fellow, ex-Saronic systems team)

pitch_note: Gov/defense buyers mean heavy compliance eventually, and SOC 2 is often the first checkbox for police-department SaaS pilots — but at 2 people, YC-only funding, no hiring, and a likely CJIS/FedRAMP-first path, this is an early nurture lead rather than an active one.

name: ComplyDo

soc2_evidence.signal: Site claims ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance and says security is 'based on ISO 27001, SOC-2, NIS-2, DORA, TISAX, and OWASP' — framework alignment language, not a SOC 2 attestation; has a Trust Center
Sells compliance automation (DORA, NIS-2, ISO 27001) to regulated enterprises — a vendor that must itself pass security review

hiring_signals: No open roles found; is_hiring=false, team of 10 (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/complydo)
aws_evidence: Site says 'Hosted where it fits best. By default on a sovereign cloud in your region' — no AWS/GCP/Azure named (https://www.complydo.io/)
pitch_note: Compliance vendor that would need SOC 2 to sell to US enterprises, but it is Berlin-based, ISO 27001-first, sovereign-cloud-hosted, and EU-regulation-focused (DORA/NIS-2) — a mismatch for a US AWS-native SOC 2 ICP unless they push into the US market.

name: Mayflower

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 or security certification mention found on mayflowervisa.com or in web search
Product plugs into enterprise HR systems and processes sensitive immigration/identity documents — buyers will require vendor security attestation

hiring_signals: No open roles found; is_hiring=false, team of 2 (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/mayflower)
aws_evidence: No cloud provider evidence found on site or job posts (https://mayflowervisa.com/)
pitch_note: Handles sensitive employee immigration documents inside enterprise HR stacks with zero published security certifications — the first mid-market HR customer security review will force SOC 2, and at F25/pre-seed they will want the fastest Type I path. Publicly listed team@ email makes outreach easy.

name: Chestnut

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 or security certification mention on chestnutmortgage.com; site shows NMLS #2688280 licensing (regulated lender) but no security/trust page
AI mortgage lender licensed in TX and CO handling borrower financial documents; lender/investor partners typically require SOC 2 from tech-enabled originators

aws_evidence: No cloud provider evidence found on site or job listings (https://chestnutmortgage.com/)
pitch_note: Regulated NMLS-licensed AI lender handling borrower financial data with no visible SOC 2, actively hiring a Founding Engineer — compliance needs will hit as they add lender partners and states. Slightly below strong-lead threshold only because buyers are consumers and total raised looks like YC-standard only.
